viewing_check: Check whether the font is genuine cranberry glass (rings when tapped, uneven colour) and the shade is original acid-etched with no chips or cracks to rim; check the burner for a maker's mark (Hinks, Youngs), whether the base is cast brass or spelter, and any hairlines in the font where the cord passes through.
